title: Death
description: What dying does, whichever rule killed the player. The feature document, death.md, is the primary record.

entities.name: Death and the return to the last save
entities.description: The ship is lost, wreckage tumbles where it was, and the game returns to the title with the last saved pilot.
entities.behavior: On a crash, a burn, a fatal docking, energy reaching 0 or the escape pod used in the Deep, the flight state is reset, a running countdown is cancelled and four wreck canisters are placed. 61 dying ticks of flight logic run without the player's controls or periodic spawning; then the title shows and the playing pilot becomes a copy of the saved one.
entities.outcome: Every launch risks what the pilot has earned since the last save.
constraints: Death starts only once (FlyInSystem::die ignores a second death).
The countdown never survives death (deliberate difference 5).

relatedViews.relationship: The pilot's goals that exercise it.
Returns to the saved pilot through Pilots::on_death.
